stories.headline: Burning tires, halted traffic: Druze protesters block Route 6 days after Tel Aviv club attack
stories.summary: The protest comes in response to an attack on three young Druze men at a club in Tel Aviv overnight between Thursday and Friday, after they were heard speaking Arabic among themselves.

stories.headline: Asher Grunis steps down from leading Submarine Affair commission due to health concerns
stories.summary: Supreme Court President Isaac Amit appointed retired Supreme Court justice Zvi Zylbertal to replace Grunis and lead the commission on Sunday.

stories.headline: Jewish Futures 2026 conference to explore how AI could reshape Jewish education
stories.summary: The event will convene Jewish educators and thought leaders to examine how artificial intelligence and emerging technologies are changing how young people learn, connect, and process information.

stories.headline: Trump rules out Sunday strike on Iran as Netanyahu warns Israel faces imminent existential threat
stories.summary: Trump also said that the US is actively monitoring activity at Iran’s Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site as well as three other sites that were allegedly destroyed in previous strikes.

stories.headline: America's Wagner Group: Starlink crisis in Ukraine shows dangerous reality for US allies - opinion
stories.summary: Almost as soon as news of the newly imposed limits was disclosed by Ukrainian officials, the game of finger-pointing between US President Donald Trump and Elon Musk, Starlink’s CEO, began.

stories.headline: Venezuela opposition leader Maria Corina Machado returns to Venezuela
stories.summary: The issue of Machado's return has strained her relationship with the US, which she has sought to cultivate as an ally since before it removed President Nicolas Maduro from power.

stories.headline: Why does Moody’s rate France above Israel? The economic gap deserves scrutiny – opinion
stories.summary: Credit ratings carry practical consequences for governments, businesses, and taxpayers. A four-notch difference deserves an explanation grounded in evidence that investors and the public can examine.

stories.headline: Board of Deputies passes motion declaring Green Party a 'racist party'
stories.summary: "By adopting an antisemitic platform, the Green Party of England and Wales has become a racist party. We will treat it accordingly," said the Board of Deputies president.

stories.headline: Netanyahu warns of sanctions, opponents warn of collapse: Who's scaring voters? - analysis
stories.summary: Netanyahu's crypto contingency plan sparked warnings of economic collapse, while his own nuclear imagery showed how both sides are stoking election fears.

stories.headline: UK arrests pro-Palestinian activist for spitting on statue of British MP murdered in terror attack
stories.summary: Essex Police arrested a man on Friday after a TikTok video showed someone spitting on a statue honoring British lawmaker Sir David Amess, who was murdered in 2021.

stories.headline: Infamous Nazi-era alpine retreat mostly destroyed in deliberate fire
stories.summary: The landmark was engulfed in flames at 9:15 p.m. local time on Friday. Police arrested a 33-year-old man suspected of deliberately starting the fire that mostly destroyed the Nazi-era retreat.

stories.headline: Sri Lanka rescues 40 Iranian sailors from international waters, facilitates return to Iran
stories.summary: The sailors from 19 ships were brought ashore at Galle Harbor, about 126 km from the commercial capital, Colombo, and were given medical treatment before returning to Iran early on Sunday morning.

stories.headline: Starlink in Ukraine Back to Normal After Week of Throttling
stories.summary: Ukrainian officials said the restrictions hampered the military's ability to intercept Russian attack drones and forced the cancelation of some operations.

stories.headline: Saudi Arabia Will Not Host Russia’s Intervision Song Contest This Year, TASS Reports
stories.summary: The decision leaves the future of Russia’s alternative to Eurovision uncertain a year after Moscow revived the Soviet-era competition.

stories.headline: Europe Should Be Included in Ukraine Peace Discussions, Kremlin Aide Says
stories.summary: "We need to talk to the whole of Europe, which fully supports Kyiv," Yury Ushakov told state television.

stories.headline: Moscow to Host 2030 World Weightlifting Championships, IWF Says
stories.summary: No world championships in an Olympic sport have been held in Russia since the start of the war in Ukraine.

stories.headline: Ukrainian Attacks Kill 5 in Belgorod and Lipetsk, Hit Perm Industrial Plant
stories.summary: Four people were killed in southwestern Russia’s Belgorod region and one in the Lipetsk region.
